8.4 Function definitions
During specification of the API functions the following guidelines were applied:
• The API functions of the Fr module shall have the return type Std_ReturnType
or void (no return code).
• If an API function of the Fr module has the return type Std_ReturnType, and if
the function performs its service successfully, then it shall return E_OK otherwise
E_NOT_OK.
• If the Fr module’s environment is passing input parameters by a reference, then
the Fr SWS shall use the const qualifier (const type *) to guarantee that it
doesn’t change the input parameter.
• For output parameters, a memory address to store the parameter is passed as
an argument.
• If API functions of the Fr module successfully finish (return E_OK), then all output
parameters shall be written with with valid values.
• If API functions of the Fr module erroneously finish (return E_NOT_OK), then no
output parameter shall be written. Output parameters shall keep their original
values in this case.
